quizName: Hardest Questions in Pennsylvania Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What is an important reason to wear a leather jacket while riding?

options.text: It makes a rider look cool.
It is usually too warm to wear when riding.
It protects you in a crash.
It should not be worn when riding.

questions.correctAnswerText: It protects you in a crash.
questions.explanation: Wear a long-sleeved jacket when riding, preferably made of leather. Leather protects your skin in a crash. Many motorcycle jackets are designed to keep you cool in hot weather.

questions.question: What type of footwear is best for riding a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Wear sturdy boots or shoes that cover your ankles. Laced-up boots or high-top shoes work best. If your laces are long, tuck them in before riding.

questions.question: Which fabric gives the best protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants offer the best protection for riders.

questions.question: When riding with a passenger, what should you do?

options.text: Start slowing sooner than you would if riding alone.
Use only your front brake to slow.
Start in the center of the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Start slowing sooner than you would if riding alone.
questions.explanation: A passenger adds weight to your motorcycle. This means it takes longer to slow down. Begin slowing sooner when you have a passenger than when riding alone.

questions.question: What is the correct way to check tire pressure?

options.text: Look at the tire to estimate pressure.
Squeeze the tire with your hand.
Compare the tire height to another tire.

questions.explanation: Use a tire gauge to check pressure before every ride. A tire that looks fine may actually be underinflated, so looking at it is not enough.

questions.question: Why is space between your motorcycle and other vehicles important?

options.text: It gives you time to react if another driver makes a mistake.
It keeps you in one area of the lane and limits your movement.
It lets you depend on others to spot hazards.
It means you need to go faster to keep up with traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: It gives you time to react if another driver makes a mistake.
questions.explanation: Keeping space around your motorcycle on all sides gives you time and room to react if another driver makes a mistake.

questions.question: Which helmet provides the most protection?

options.text: A helmet that meets U.S. DOT standards.
A helmet that survived a previous crash.
A helmet that provides hearing protection.

questions.correctAnswerText: A helmet that meets U.S. DOT standards.
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and state standards for the best protection. The helmet should fit snugly all the way around your head.

questions.question: What should you do if a friend has drunk too much and wants to ride their motorcycle?

options.text: Suggest they use less crowded roads.

questions.explanation: Never let someone ride if they have had too much to drink. Stop them from riding by taking their keys if needed. Arrange another way for them to get home.

questions.question: How can you reduce head and neck injuries?
questions.explanation: A high-quality helmet greatly reduces the risk of head and neck injuries. A helmet is your best defense against injury in an accident.

questions.question: Where should you find information specific to your motorcycle?

options.text: Someone who rides a different type of motorcycle.
A television show about motorcycle riding.

questions.explanation: Read the owner's manual before riding your motorcycle for the first time. This is especially important if you are riding a borrowed motorcycle.

questions.question: Wet surfaces make it hard to control a motorcycle. Which of these is a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: Slippery surfaces include wet pavement, loose gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lane markings, and metal covers in the road. Ride slowly and carefully on these surfaces.

questions.question: For the best protection, wear a helmet that:
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and state standards. It should fit snugly all around and have no obvious damage.

questions.question: Proper motorcycle riding clothes should:

options.text: Cover your arms and legs completely.
Cover your arms completely, but leave your legs exposed.
Cover your legs completely, but leave your arms exposed.
Be whatever makes you most comfortable, regardless of safety.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cover your arms and legs completely.
questions.explanation: Wear a jacket and pants that completely cover your arms and legs to stay protected while riding.

questions.question: The only way to get alcohol out of your body is through:
questions.explanation: Only time allows your body to remove alcohol. There are no shortcuts to becoming sober.

questions.question: Goggles will:

options.text: Be equally as effective as a face shield.
Offer the same protection as a windshield.
Provide protection for your entire face.

questions.explanation: Goggles protect only your eyes. A face shield protects your whole face and is better. A windshield does not replace a face shield or goggles.

questions.question: ____ can remove alcohol and its effects from your body.
questions.explanation: Only time reduces your blood alcohol level. Coffee, exercise, fresh air, and cold showers cannot lower your blood alcohol or make you sober. They may keep you awake, but they do not change how alcohol affects you.

questions.question: Keeping space around your motorcycle:

options.text: Is only necessary for beginning motorcyclists.
Gives you time and space to avoid hazards.
Lets you weave through traffic when you need to.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gives you time and space to avoid hazards.
questions.explanation: Keep distance from other vehicles to protect yourself. Space around your motorcycle gives you time to react and move around any danger.

questions.question: Use a turn signal:

options.text: When you're planning to increase your speed.
Only when there is a lot of traffic.
Any time you plan on changing lanes.
Only if it is dark outside.

questions.correctAnswerText: Any time you plan on changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Use your turn signal every time you turn or change lanes, even if you think no one is watching.

questions.question: For best protection, boots or shoes should:

options.text: Be made of a soft material.
Have long laces that are not tucked in.
Cover the ankle and provide support.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cover the ankle and provide support.
questions.explanation: Wear tall, sturdy boots or shoes that cover and support your ankles. Use low heels so they don't catch on surfaces. Tuck in long laces so they don't get caught in the motorcycle.

questions.question: As a motorcycle rider, you can help others see you by:
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors, keep your headlight on at all times, and use your turn signals to help others see you.
